verse.verse_1: I CALL TO witness the early hours of morning,
verse.verse_2: And the night when dark and still,
verse.verse_3: Your Lord has neither left you, nor despises you.
verse.verse_4: What is to come is better for you than what has gone before;
verse.verse_5: For your Lord will certainly give you, and you will be content.
verse.verse_6: Did He not find you an orphan and take care of you?
verse.verse_7: Did He not find you perplexed, and show you the way?
verse.verse_8: Did He not find you poor and enrich you?
verse.verse_9: So do not oppress the orphan,
verse.verse_10: And do not drive the beggar away,
verse.verse_11: And keep recounting the favours of your Lord.
